description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log output by only passing message content to the next LogNode in the chain, ignoring other metadata like priority, tags, or exceptions.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that outputs only the log message, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message part to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
